question: Select the Chinese greeting for “hello.”
explanation: 你好 (nǐ hǎo) is the standard friendly greeting. Literally, the characters mean “you good.”

question: Select the polite request for help.
explanation: 可以 (kěyǐ) means “can/may”; 帮我 (bāng wǒ) means “help me.” 吗 / 嗎 turns the phrase into a yes-or-no question.

question: Select the sentence expressing a positive opinion.
options: I think this is a good idea
I forgot to bring my keys
optionPinyin: tā bǐ wǒ lái de zǎo
explanation: 我觉得 / 我覺得 (wǒ juéde) means “I think,” while 不错 / 不錯 (búcuò) means “not bad” or “pretty good.”

question: Select the sentence using an “although…but” contrast.
options: If I have time, I'll go
Although I was tired, I still finished the work
Because it rained, we didn't go out
It is not only cheap, but also useful
simplifiedOptions: 虽然很累，但是我还是完成了工作。
因为下雨，所以我们没出门。
traditionalOptions: 雖然很累，但是我還是完成了工作。
因為下雨，所以我們沒出門。
optionPinyin: rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù qù
suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ háishi wánchéng le gōngzuò
yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen méi chūmén
bùdàn piányi, érqiě hěn hǎo yòng
explanation: 虽然 / 雖然 (suīrán) introduces a concession (“although”); 但是 (dànshì) introduces the contrast (“but”).

question: Select the Chinese question “What is this?”
explanation: 这 / 這 (zhè) means “this,” 是 (shì) means “is,” and 什么 / 什麼 (shénme) means “what.”

question: Select the sentence about plans for next month.
options: I have already travelled for a month
I plan to travel next month
optionPinyin: wǒ yǐjīng lǚxíng le yí ge yuè
wǒ dǎsuàn xià ge yuè qù lǚxíng
wǒ měi ge yuè dōu hěn máng
wǒ bú tài xǐhuan zuò fēijī
explanation: 打算 (dǎsuàn) means “to plan to,” and 下个月 / 下個月 (xià ge yuè) means “next month.”

question: Select the sentence about commuting by bus every day.
options: I take the bus to work every day
I cook at home on weekends
I usually get up at seven
optionPinyin: wǒ zhōumò zài jiā zuò fàn
explanation: 每天 (měitiān) means “every day”; 坐公交车 / 坐公車 (zuò gōngjiāochē) means “take the bus.”

question: Select the conditional sentence about preparing in advance.
options: If we prepare in advance, we won't be so nervous
simplifiedOptions: 我们虽然很忙，但是很开心。
如果提前准备，就不会这么紧张。
我们一边吃饭，一边聊天。
traditionalOptions: 我們雖然很忙，但是很開心。
如果提前準備，就不會這麼緊張。
我們一邊吃飯，一邊聊天。
optionPinyin: wǒmen suīrán hěn máng, dànshì hěn kāixīn
wǒmen zhǔnbèi de bǐ zuótiān hǎo
rúguǒ tíqián zhǔnbèi, jiù bú huì zhème jǐnzhāng
explanation: 如果 (rúguǒ) means “if,” and 就 (jiù) introduces the result. 提前 (tíqián) means “in advance.”

question: Select the sentence expressing a preference for tea.
options: I want to buy a cup of water
optionPinyin: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì bēi shuǐ
explanation: 比较 / 比較 (bǐjiào) softens a comparison and here means “rather/prefer”; 喜欢 / 喜歡 (xǐhuan) means “like.”

question: Select the sentence about a first visit to China.
options: I visited China twice last year
This is my first time visiting China
My friend lives in northern China
I plan to work in China for three years
simplifiedOptions: 我打算在中国工作三年。
traditionalOptions: 我打算在中國工作三年。
optionPinyin: wǒ qùnián qù guo Zhōngguó liǎng cì
zhè shì wǒ dì-yī cì lái Zhōngguó
wǒ péngyou zhù zài Zhōngguó běifāng
wǒ dǎsuàn zài Zhōngguó gōngzuò sān nián
explanation: 第一次 (dì-yī cì) means “the first time.” 来中国 / 來中國 (lái Zhōngguó) means “come to China.”
